title: A Locker for the Yearbook
author: Petra Marchetti
blurb: Freya Okonkwo, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
